findings.title: CI red on 0a71983: pnpm-lock.yaml out of sync (ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE)
findings.claim: exists commit c in history: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile fails; no guard prevents recurrence
findings.observed: ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE; fixed in 0d181f6 with no guard; devcontainer post-create.sh:15 same failure
findings.fix: Required CI on main; pre-push lockfile check.

findings.title: tests/firebase/rules.test.ts is 0 bytes; test:rules passes vacuously, CI never runs it
findings.claim: forall rules R: test:rules exit 0 regardless of firestore.rules content
findings.witness: wc -c tests/firebase/rules.test.ts; node --test --import tsx tests/firebase/rules.test.ts; echo $?
findings.observed: 0 bytes, exit 0; ci.yml has no test:rules step; I13 unverified
findings.fix: Write emulator tests (cross-uid, event update/delete, dashboard write); add CI job; fail on empty file.

findings.title: ADR 0003 reserves web/ with own package.json; structure checker rejects it
findings.claim: ADR 0003 workspace split => verify:repo exit 1; nothing enforces 'web imports only cws/core'
findings.witness: mkdir web && echo {} > web/package.json && node scripts/check-repo-structure.mjs
findings.observed: exit 1: nested package manifest is not allowed: web/package.json
findings.fix: Allowlist web/ per ADR 0003 and add web import check, or amend ADR.

findings.title: Structure checker import scan is regex-only: archive imports, require() and devDependency-in-src pass
findings.claim: exists src file importing ../archive/v1 or require('x') or a devDependency: verify:repo exit 0
findings.witness: echo "import '../archive/v1/x.js'; const f=require('left-pad');" > src/zz.ts && node scripts/check-repo-structure.mjs
findings.observed: static reading: relative specifiers skipped, require not matched, declared set includes devDependencies
findings.fix: Resolve relative imports against ignoredDirs; match require(); check src against dependencies only.

findings.title: format:check scans git-ignored dirs, so npm run verify fails on scratch dirs
findings.claim: exists ignored dir with trailing-whitespace file: format:check exit 1 though git ignores it
findings.witness: mkdir scratchpad && echo 'x  ' > scratchpad/a.md && node scripts/check-format.mjs
findings.fix: Use git ls-files as the file list.

findings.title: CI runs the whole suite twice (npm test then npm run coverage) on 2 OSes
findings.claim: coverage = c8 ... npm test, so each test executes twice per matrix leg
findings.witness: grep -n 'npm test\|npm run coverage' .github/workflows/ci.yml; grep coverage package.json
findings.observed: test step then coverage step re-invoking npm test
findings.fix: Drop the plain npm test step.

findings.title: Actions tag-pinned; no timeout or concurrency; no engines field
findings.claim: checkout/pnpm/setup-node @v4 mutable; no timeout-minutes/concurrency; package.json lacks engines though Node 24 and TS 7 needed
findings.observed: 3 tag-pinned uses, no timeout/concurrency, engines count 0
findings.fix: Pin SHAs, add timeout-minutes, concurrency, engines.node.

findings.title: Heavy devDependencies (firebase-tools, Stryker) on every CI install; no audit step
findings.claim: large supply-chain surface installed per run; CI has no pnpm audit or dependency review
findings.fix: Optional CI job for heavy tools; dependency-review action.

findings.title: devcontainer post-create installs unpinned global npm/pip packages; failures swallowed
findings.claim: post-create.sh installs 4 agent CLIs and uv unpinned via optional() and overwrites global bin/cws
findings.observed: latest-tag installs; optional() converts failure to warning; no curl|sh found
findings.fix: Pin versions; summarize failed optional steps.

findings.title: No secret scan in CI; gitleaks hit is a placeholder token with no allowlist
findings.claim: gitleaks gitlab-pat at d641151:tests/findings-hardening.test.ts:221 is literal glpat-<20-char-fake> (fake); HEAD builds it at runtime via fakeSecret; nothing stops a future real leak
findings.observed: placeholder literal in old commit, not a real secret; ci.yml has no gitleaks, no .gitleaks.toml

findings.title: README says safe-run blocks destructive git forms; rebase -x, bisect run, submodule foreach, log --output allowed
findings.claim: exists cmd in {git rebase -x, git bisect run, git submodule foreach, git log --output=.git/config}: safe-run --check allows it
findings.witness: node --import tsx src/cli/main.ts safe-run --check -- git rebase -x id HEAD
